title: Tunisian-Style Grilled Kebabs with Provolone
description: A Mediterranean-inspired dish featuring marinated kebabs grilled to perfection and served with melted provolone cheese.
instructions: 2. In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and black pepper.
3. Add kebabs to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
4. Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, slice provolone cheese into 1/4-inch thick rounds.
6. Once kebabs are cooked, transfer them to a serving platter.
7. Top each kebab with a round of provolone cheese.
8. Return the platter to the grill for 1-2 minutes, or until cheese is melted and slightly browned.
9. Garnish with chopped parsley, if desired.
